description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Niwandama, Ja-ela D/S Division, Gampaha District (25/5514112)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration, specifically the determination and registration of title for specific land parcels (Parcel Nos. 14:1, 14:2, 14:3, 14:4) in Niwandama village. It involves the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement exercising powers under the Registration of Title Act to declare ownership details, which falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
